=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:388-397 (+ .github/workflows/implement.yml:5463-5471) | severity=high | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: The documented off switch IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADDS_ENABLED is never mapped from `vars.IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADDS_ENABLED` into the implement workflow or job env (including the "Commit changes" step env at implement.yml:5463-5471), so the script sees it as unset and the `''|true)` case turns staging on.
  WHY: An operator who sets the repository variable to `false`, as the README and changelog describe, still gets self-repo `.github/ai` staging, because implement.yml:84-85 notes that vars.* are not auto-exposed to the shell. The kill switch is dead in the shipped workflow. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. Suggested fix: add `IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADDS_ENABLED: ${{ vars.IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADDS_ENABLED || 'true' }}` to the workflow-level env and to the job env blocks that map sibling toggles (~5347, 5464, 5499). implement.yml is outside files_touched and is an automation path; sonnet's in-scope fallback is to reword the README and changelog.
- (no repository file; CI check-run `copilot-pull-request-reviewer` on head 1bc143f2) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Copilot reviewer check-run fails with "Error: Prompt too big after adding system message" (errorCode custom_instructions_too_large, statusCode 422) before it analyses the diff.
  WHY: The cause is the size of the repository's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md custom instructions, not any hunk in this PR. The editor should take no action in the changed files. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
